sources.snippet: GigaChat 3.1 Lightning is the compact instruct model of the GigaChat 3.1 family. It is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 10B total parameters and 1.8B active parameters, designed for fast multilingual assistant workloads, reasoning, code, function calling, and product-style deployment. This repository contains the BF16 version of the model.

sources.title: Data Models Overview | ai-forever/gigachat | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document catalogs all Pydantic data models exported by the gigachat.models package. These models provide type-safe representations of requests, responses, and entities used throughout the GigaChat library. All models inherit from pydantic.BaseModel and provide automatic validation, serialization, and documentation.
